speaker: jabez-mother
text: Because I bore him in pain.
name: Jabez's mother

speaker: jabez
text: If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.
name: Jabez

speaker: saul
text: Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!
name: Saul

speaker: israelites
text: Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
name: All Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’
name: All Israel

speaker: jebusites
text: You will never get in here.
name: The people of Jebus

speaker: david
text: Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?
name: David

speaker: david
text: If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.
name: David

speaker: amasai
text: We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.
name: Amasai

speaker: philistine-rulers
text: It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.
name: The Philistine rulers

speaker: david
text: If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then let us bring back the ark of our God, for we did not inquire of Him in the days of Saul.
name: David

speaker: david
text: How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I will deliver them into your hand.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Do not march up after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
name: David

speaker: david
text: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
name: David

speaker: david
text: O offspring of His servant Israel, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
name: David

speaker: david
text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
name: David

speaker: david
text: ‘I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
name: David

speaker: david
text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
name: David

speaker: david
text: ‘Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
name: David

speaker: david
text: tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
name: David

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!
name: All Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Praise the LORD!
name: All Israel

speaker: david
text: Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.
name: David

speaker: nathan
text: Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: god
text: Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
name: David

speaker: david
text: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: What more can David say to You for so honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,
name: David

speaker: david
text: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed all Your greatness.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
name: David

speaker: david
text: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
name: David

speaker: david
text: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.
name: David

speaker: ammonite-princes
text: Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Have not his servants come to you to explore the land, spy it out, and overthrow it?
name: The Ammonite princes

speaker: david
text: Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: If the Arameans are too strong for me,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan and bring me a report, so that I may know their number.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: May the LORD multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. Now I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: gad
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
name: Gad the prophet

speaker: gad
text: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of the LORD—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.
name: Gad the prophet

speaker: david
text: I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Enough! Withdraw your hand now!
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.
name: David

speaker: ornan
text: My lord the king may take whatever seems good. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering—I will give it all.
name: Ornan the Jebusite

speaker: david
text: No,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.
name: David

speaker: david
text: My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.
name: David

speaker: david
text: My son,
name: David

speaker: david
text: it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
name: David

speaker: david
text: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work—
name: David

speaker: david
text: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Get started building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Of these,
name: David

speaker: david
text: 24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges,
name: David

speaker: david
text: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
name: David

speaker: david
text: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has spilled blood.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever. For He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah He chose my father’s household, and from my father’s sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And of all my sons—for the LORD has given me many sons—He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And He said to me, ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as My son, and I will be his Father.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances, as is being done this day.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.
name: David

speaker: david
text: All this,
name: David

speaker: david
text: all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.
name: David

speaker: david
text: My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I now give for it my personal treasures of gold and silver, over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple:
name: David

speaker: david
text: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings,
name: David

speaker: david
text: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who will volunteer to consecrate himself to the LORD today?
name: David

speaker: david
text: May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Blessed be the LORD your God.
name: David
